name: macos-hardware-issues
title: Hardware Issues
description: Problem devices, disk health, battery, memory and hardware error events

checks.title: Storage devices and SMART status
command: for d in $(diskutil list 2>/dev/null | grep -Eo '^/dev/disk[0-9]+' | sort -u); do
diskutil info "$d" 2>/dev/null | grep -E 'Device / Media Name|SMART Status|Solid State|Disk Size|Protocol'

checks.title: Battery condition
command: system_profiler SPPowerDataType 2>/dev/null | grep -E 'Cycle Count|Condition|Maximum Capacity|Full Charge Capacity|State of Charge'

checks.title: USB devices
command: system_profiler SPUSBDataType 2>/dev/null | grep -E '^\s{4,8}[A-Za-z].*:$|Product ID|Vendor ID|Serial Number' | head -60

checks.title: Recent kernel/hardware errors (last hour)
command: log show --last 1h --predicate 'process == "kernel" AND (eventMessage CONTAINS[c] "error" OR eventMessage CONTAINS[c] "fault")' --style compact 2>/dev/null | tail -30
